$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ImportReceipt per INT-024 (docs/ratified/IMPORT_RECEIPT_V1.md) — step 6 ('Receipt') of the six-step manual import grammar (INT-011): source digest, decisions, resulting objects, errors, backlinks. Append-only (FB-RAT-COM-006) — a correction is a NEW receipt, never an in-place edit of an existing one. schemaVersion pinned to major 1, FB-RAT-COM-003.
title: ImportReceipt
description: The durable record of one confirmed import action, produced only after the user's explicit Confirm (step 5, INT-005/INT-011). `rejected` records here are FINAL rejections carried into the receipt (structural or record-level errors, or user-declined conflicts) — distinct from ImportPreview.rejectedRecords, which is the pre-mutation forecast of the same vocabulary.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this receipt shape. A reader MUST reject any schemaVersion whose major is not '1' (FB-RAT-COM-003).

receiptId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this receipt (FB-RAT-COM-002). Also usable as the idempotency anchor a retried Confirm tap resolves to, per FB-RAT-COM-006.

sourceLocation.description: Backlink to where the source was read from (file path, or repo+branch+commit for Assay) — FB-RAT-COM-008 provenance.

previewId.description: Backlink to the ImportPreview.previewId the user reviewed before confirming (schemas/integrations/import-preview.v1.schema.json). Null only for a hypothetical direct-confirm path this domain does not otherwise define — every real flow in docs/ratified/MANUAL_INTEGRATION_GRAMMAR.md goes through a preview first.

initiatedBy.description: The initiating principal (FB-RAT-COM-008) — who performed the explicit user action (INT-001) that produced this receipt. Every cross-app transfer begins with one; this field is where that action's actor is recorded.

decision.description: FULL: every new/changed/duplicate-eligible record the preview offered was imported as offered. PARTIAL: the user explicitly excluded at least one otherwise-importable record (INT-007 'no silent partial import' — PARTIAL MUST correspond to an explicit confirmation step, never an implicit default). Records that were IMPORT_* rejected before the user ever saw a choice (schema/digest/project-mismatch failures) do not by themselves make a decision PARTIAL — that column is about user-elected exclusions.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this receipt was produced (FB-RAT-COM-004).

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

IntegrityRef.description: Duplicated from schemas/common/artifact-ref.schema.json's $defs/IntegrityRef per this repo's cross-file convention (docs/ratified/COMMON_CONVENTIONS.md §5).

ImportErrorCode.description: Same closed+open vocabulary as import-preview.v1.schema.json's $defs/ImportErrorCode, duplicated per this repo's cross-file convention. See docs/ratified/MANUAL_INTEGRATION_GRAMMAR.md's error taxonomy and docs/ratified/IMPORT_RECEIPT_V1.md's IMPORT_INVALID_<FIELD> family definition.

incidentId.description: Imports create/update Incidents, NEVER Tasks (INT-016) — this field is always an Incident id, by construction of this shape, not by a runtime check alone.

sourceLocation.description: Where within the source this rejected record was found. A reader that resolves this into an actual filesystem/repo path MUST reject any '..' segment first (see fixtures/integrations/adversarial/import-receipt-path-traversal-sourcelocation.adversarial.json — this field's type is a bare string, so JSON Schema cannot catch that case structurally).
